Tarikh | Episode 1069 | 25 Sep 2025
This episode of Tarikh explores the fascinating origins of common words and names that turned into powerful terms over time. From boycott born out of Charles Boycott’s story in Ireland, to lynching rooted in American racial history, to the wrongful trial of Leo Frank, the quirky tale behind the ‘sandwich’, and the cultural evolution of ‘Karen’ as a modern insult. A journey through history, language, and society, showing how names shape meanings and reputations.
Production: Anubhav Bajpai
Video Editor: Goransh
